description: Cavity charge composition across SLC25 substrate classes, with MRX20 positioned
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
T=pd.read_csv("cavity_residues_panel.tsv",sep="\t")
cls={"MRX20_YFR045W":"unknown","CTP1":"tricarboxylate","hSLC25A1":"tricarboxylate","YHM2":"tricarboxylate",
"SFC1":"dicarboxylate","DIC1":"dicarboxylate","hSLC25A10":"dicarboxylate","hSLC25A11":"dicarboxylate","OAC1":"dicarboxylate",
"ODC1":"oxodicarboxylate","ODC2":"oxodicarboxylate","hSLC25A21":"oxodicarboxylate",
"PET9_AAC2":"nucleotide","bAAC1":"nucleotide","GGC1":"nucleotide","RIM2":"nucleotide",
"MIR1":"phosphate","PIC2":"phosphate","LEU5":"CoA/FAD/ThPP","FLX1":"CoA/FAD/ThPP","TPC1":"CoA/FAD/ThPP",
"PET8":"cationic/zwitterion","ORT1":"cationic/zwitterion","CRC1":"cationic/zwitterion",
"HEM25":"amino acid","YMC1":"amino acid","MRS3":"metal","MTM1":"metal","MME1":"metal","YPR011C":"unknown"}
T["class"]=T.carrier.map(cls)
T["frac_basic"]=T.basic/T.n_cavity
order=["tricarboxylate","dicarboxylate","oxodicarboxylate","nucleotide","phosphate","CoA/FAD/ThPP","amino acid","cationic/zwitterion","metal","unknown"]
cmap={"tricarboxylate":"#b03a2e","dicarboxylate":"#d68910","oxodicarboxylate":"#7d6608","nucleotide":"#1f618d",
"phosphate":"#2e86c1","CoA/FAD/ThPP":"#6c3483","amino acid":"#117a65","cationic/zwitterion":"#148f77","metal":"#515a5a","unknown":"#000000"}
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,5.6))
ax=axes[0]
T2=T.sort_values(["class","net_charge"],key=lambda s:s.map({c:i for i,c in enumerate(order)}) if s.name=="class" else s)
y=np.arange(len(T2))
ax.barh(y,T2.net_charge,color=[cmap[c] for c in T2["class"]],
        edgecolor=["black" if c=="MRX20_YFR045W" else "none" for c in T2.carrier],linewidth=1.6)
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels([c.replace("_YFR045W","") for c in T2.carrier],fontsize=8.5)
for t,c in zip(ax.get_yticklabels(),T2.carrier):
    if c=="MRX20_YFR045W": t.set_fontweight("bold")
ax.invert_yaxis(); ax.axvline(0,color="k",lw=.8)
ax.set_xlabel("net charge of substrate-site residues (basic minus acidic)")
ax.set_title("Charge of the central cavity at the substrate site\n(AlphaFold models, residues 4-16 A above the matrix salt-bridge network)",fontsize=10)

ax=axes[1]
for c in order:
    s=T[T["class"]==c]
    ax.scatter(s.basic,s.acidic,s=70,color=cmap[c],label=c,edgecolor="white",zorder=3)
m=T[T.carrier=="MRX20_YFR045W"]
ax.scatter(m.basic,m.acidic,s=260,facecolor="none",edgecolor="black",lw=2,zorder=4)
ax.annotate("MRX20",(m.basic.values[0],m.acidic.values[0]),xytext=(8,10),textcoords="offset points",fontweight="bold")
for _,r in T[T.carrier.isin(["CTP1","SFC1","hSLC25A1","DIC1","ORT1","PET9_AAC2"])].iterrows():
    ax.annotate(r.carrier,(r.basic,r.acidic),xytext=(6,-10),textcoords="offset points",fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel("basic residues at substrate site"); ax.set_ylabel("acidic residues at substrate site")
ax.legend(fontsize=7.5,ncol=2,frameon=False); ax.set_title("MRX20 sits with the anionic-carboxylate carriers",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
T.to_csv("cavity_residues_panel_classified.tsv",sep="\t",index=False)
print(T[["carrier","class","n_cavity","basic","acidic","net_charge"]].sort_values("net_charge",ascending=False).to_string(index=False))
